# Personal data inventory

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_privacy_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This inventory is generated from the registry used by subject access, erasure,
and retention. A row with no subject link is an explicit no-personal-data
decision, not an unreviewed omission.

| Table | Subject link | Purpose | Erasure | Retention | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agent_recommendations` | user_id_int through decided_by_user_id | Proposed mitigations and who approved or rejected each one. | anonymise | No automatic expiry | The approver is nulled rather than the decision deleted: an approval trail that disappears with its author is not a trail. The row itself goes when the run does. |
| `agent_runs` | user_id_int through requested_by_user_id | Which supplier a named person asked to have analysed, and when. | delete | 400 days from started_at | — |

Erasing a row would mean dropping those triggers, destroying the guarantee for every other row. OWNER INPUT REQUIRED: this ground needs legal confirmation. |
